8.0 Criteria for Response
8.1 Complete Hematologic Remission (CHR) - normalization for at least 4 weeks of the bone marrow (less than 5% blasts) and peripheral blood with WBC < 10 x 109/L and no peripheral blasts, promyelocytes or myelocytes. This is in addition to disappearance of all signs and symptoms of the disease.
Partial Hematologic Response (PHR) = CHR except for persistence of immature cells (myelocytes, metamyelocytes), or splenomegaly < 50% of pretreatment, or thrombocytosis >450x109/L but <50% of pretreatment.
8.2 Complete hematologic remission will further be classified according to suppression of the Philadelphia chromosome (Ph) by cytogenetics or i FISH
a) No cytogenetic response - Ph positive 100% of pretreatment value
b) Minor cytogenetic response - Ph positive 35-90% of pretreatment value
c) Partial cytogenetic response - Ph positive 1-34% of pretreatment value
d) Complete cytogenetic response - Ph positive 0%
* Major cytogenetic response = complete + partial (Ph positive <35%)
8.3 Molecular response = PCR ratio ≤ 0.05%, or PCR negative
